observed: Two earlier attempts were wrong in the same way. First the desk and the bridge signed while still serving their own hand-rolled pages. Then the server was made to render each window from settings.html (`app_base.render_window`) and to refuse any app whose disk page differed; the served desk came back as an unstyled skeleton with the settings head and none of the desk's look, which the owner photographed. The owner's rule: "the apps must deliver their windows the same way the settings window does".
correction: The render-copy path is removed: app_base.render_window and the app-not-from-settings-window refusal are gone, and /toast.html and /bridge.html are served as the apps' own signed pages again. Delivery is now uniform and enforced: each window page carries data-window="popit-<name>-package" (dialin, bridge, settings), app_package refuses a page that does not name its delivered window (app-not-delivered-as-window), and ui/phone.js opens every app through one helper in its own named window with the geometry from the published layout — the SETTINGS_WINDOW special case is gone. Gate leg apps-deliver-windows-like-the-settings-window reads the pages, phone.js and app_package together.
measured: Live registry after POST /api/toast/apps/ensure: dialin@40, bridge@10, settings@31, springboard@41 all signed; /toast.html 200 (17404 bytes, data-window + data-chrome), /bridge.html 200 (3509 bytes), /settings.html 200 (8438 bytes); tools/app_package_probe.py 21 passed / 0 failed; python tools/landing.py rewrote docs/; tools/app_store.py wrote 3 packages, 0 refused; tools/freshness.py probe 7 passed / 0 failed with 5 stale rows (four ui audits and the dialin rebuild), each naming its driver act; tools/gate.py 62 checks after the rebuild row is cleared.

observed: logs/authority/2026-11-25-windows-are-copies-of-the-settings-window.jsonl recorded a rule that a window is a byte-for-byte server render of settings.html and that a hand-rolled page is refused as app-not-from-settings-window.
correction: That rule is superseded by this row. A window is delivered the way the settings window is delivered — its own signed page, opened in its own named window by the shell — not rendered by another app's server route. The copy render produced an unstyled window because it kept settings.html's head and dropped the app's sheets; it is removed rather than kept beside the delivery rule.
